meta.name: contract-review
meta.description: Contract review skill that adds comment-based issue annotations without changing original text. Enforces a three-layer review (basic, business, legal), writes structured comments (issue type, risk reason, revision suggestion) with risk level encoded via reviewer name, and generates a contract summary, consolidated opinion, and Mermaid business flowchart (with rendered image). Output language must follow the contract’s language.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查合同并添加结构化批注与摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速审查合同条款并生成风险摘要
copy.tagline_en: Review contracts with structured annotations and summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly review contract clauses and generate risk summaries

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会审查上传的合同文档:只加批注、不改原文,按基础、商业、法律三层检查条款;随后生成合同摘要、综合审核意见和业务流程图(含渲染图片),输出语言跟随合同原文。
howto.when: 当用户上传 .docx 格式的合同文件,并提出审查、审核等要求时触发。

say.text: 请审查这份合同,重点看付款条款和违约责任。
say.note: 会按三层模型加批注并生成审核报告。

say.text: 用中文输出合同摘要和综合审核意见。
say.note: 生成内容会跟随合同语言,此处应为中文。

say.text: 把合同里的业务流程画成流程图给我。
say.note: 会生成 Mermaid 源文件和 PNG 图片。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews an uploaded .docx contract, adds comments only (no text edits), checks three layers (basic/business/legal), then outputs a contract summary, consolidated opinion, and rendered flowchart in the contract's language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user uploads a .docx contract and asks for a review or audit.

say_en.text: Review this contract; focus on payment terms and breach liability.
say_en.note: Comments and reports follow the three-layer review.

say_en.text: Produce the contract summary and consolidated opinion in Chinese.
say_en.note: Output follows the contract language; Chinese here.

say_en.text: Turn the contract's business flow into a diagram for me.
say_en.note: It will output a Mermaid file and a PNG image.
